items.title: AI-assisted method advances high-resolution structure classification of membrane proteins in vesicles
items.excerpt: Institute of Biophysics, CAS (PNAS): isSPA-vesicle uses an AI model to fit vesicle-membrane geometry and filter mis-oriented particles, yielding 2.7 Å and 3.1 Å in-membrane structures of influenza hemagglutinin and coronavirus OC43 spike.

items.title: Hidden leaf dynamics could improve Amazon rainforest carbon uptake estimates
items.excerpt: University of Hong Kong (Nature): machine learning on 10 m Sentinel-2 imagery (2019-2021) maps monthly leaf loss across the Amazon; accounting for leaf renewal shifts modeled annual carbon uptake by about 9.4%. Remote-sensing angle (deprioritized ecology).

items.title: Researchers use AI to optimize sensor design for ultrasensitive vitamin C detection
items.excerpt: Sungkyunkwan University (Chemical Engineering Journal): an ML model trained on 25 experiments picked fabrication settings from 625 combinations for a molecularly imprinted polymer sensor; built sensor reached a 778 pM detection limit and tracked ELISA in urine.

items.title: Scientists Use AI-Designed CRISPR to Make Disease-Resistant Rice
items.excerpt: University of Missouri (Bing Yang) adapted Profluent's AI-designed OpenCRISPR-1 for rice, knocking out three SWEET genes with up to 97% efficiency; edited plants resisted three Xoo blight strains and passed edits to offspring.

history_match.title: Rice plants can fight off devastating disease after gene editing with AI-designed tool

items.title: Many languages, one common neural code
items.excerpt: MIT McGovern (Nature): analyzing speakers of 21 languages with a multilingual AI model, the study finds the human brain may represent meaning in much the same way across languages. Note: brain-model alignment angle (deprioritized).

items.title: AI-driven technique could help engineers design analog chips faster and with less expense
items.excerpt: MIT SLIC training teaches a small generative model to design analog integrated circuits as well as or better than frontier LLMs. Engineering-design angle; may fit gadgets better.

items.title: A legendary philosopher isn't buying Anthropic's consciousness argument
items.excerpt: Anthropic warned investors its AI might be conscious; a leading philosopher of mind rejects the argument, probing what AI-welfare research actually shows. Commentary/feature rather than new data.

items.title: One in four students turn to AI for mental health support
items.excerpt: University of Bath (JMIR Mental Health): survey of 2,020 UK students finds about one in four used generative AI for mental-health support in six months, highest among those with very low well-being. Cross-sectional survey (attitude-survey caveat).

items.title: ChatGPT's translation of mental health questionnaires into Mandarin reveals inconsistent results
items.excerpt: University of Canterbury (Wei Teng): engineered prompts made ChatGPT's Mandarin K10/PHQ-9 translations more natural, but the same prompt gave inconsistent outputs across user accounts, raising reliability concerns for psychological assessment.

items.title: AI can identify themes in human interviews but still misses nuances in meaning
items.excerpt: University of Missouri (Int. J. Qualitative Methods): AURA framework compared BERTopic with human coders on 32 interviews; 11 of 12 human themes matched an AI topic, but AI merged/split themes and missed nuance.

items.title: Neural networks that behave identically reveal hidden structural differences as they learn
items.excerpt: Technion (arXiv 2605.04115, NeurIPS 2026 oral): RNNs with identical behavior carry hidden structural differences that surface only when learning a new task and retain traces of past training; proposes tests for biological circuits.

history_match.title: Fractal patterns reveal hidden limits to AI predictability

items.title: Your Best Quantum Error Correction Engineer Might Be a Bot
items.excerpt: GQI analysis of how AI increasingly assists engineers in designing new quantum error-correction codes and decoders. Analysis piece, no single new result.

history_match.title: Yonsei University Researchers Develop Mamba State-Space Neural Decoder to Enable Real-Time Quantum Error Correction

items.title: Machine learning-driven regulation of the four-electron LiOH pathway in lithium-oxygen batteries with prolonged cycling
items.excerpt: Authors use machine learning to identify a Ni-Co dual-atom catalyst that promotes a four-electron LiOH pathway in Li-O2 batteries, reaching ~60,000 mAh/g capacity and over 2,000 stable cycles.
